description: Mails from addresses on no customer's domain, each carrying the fictional M15 purchase order (whose buyer, Talverra, is no customer), so DW1 routes each `customer_unknown`. What the mail says decides whose it is; `expected` is the customer that wrote it, or null. Fictional names and domains only.
